jobs.title: Project Officer (all genders) - Negotiation Support to Resistance and Liberation Movements
jobs.reason: The role requires C1-level French as an essential ("Excellent verbal and written language skills in English and in French (at least C1-level)"), which the candidate's B1 French does not meet — a hard disqualifier. This is a shame, as peacebuilding, negotiation support and transitional processes sit squarely in the candidate's core interest zone.

jobs.title: Ranking Manager (m/f/x)
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title and requirements point to an operational, CRM/process-management role rather than an entry-level research post, and the essentials (hands-on Salesforce/CRM experience, process automation, predictive analytics modelling, stakeholder management) sit largely outside the candidate's research-and-writing profile — though the candidate's higher-education-policy RA experience gives a partial thematic link. The role is not squarely a Senior/Lead level despite the title and doesn't demand years of experience as an essential, so it stays eligible, but it is a weak fit on both skills and interest.

jobs.title: Project Officer (all genders) - Servicestelle Friedensbildung / Service Center Peace Education
jobs.reason: The role appears to be an entry-to-junior project/administrative post at a respected peace-research foundation, and the candidate's project-administration and event-support experience (German Rectors' Conference) transfer well. The description is minimal, so paper-fit is uncertain, and peace education is adjacent rather than core to the candidate's international-law/atrocity focus; a German-language pedagogy service center may also lean toward education-specialist skills the candidate lacks. Native German is an asset if required.

jobs.title: Roving Grants and Compliance Advisor*in
jobs.reason: Fails multiple hard essentials: it requires fluent French alongside German and English (candidate is only B1 French), and it demands roughly three years of relevant professional experience plus multi-year project-finance-management experience the candidate lacks. It is also a grant-compliance and financial-management role rather than the candidate's research/policy focus, so interest is low even setting aside the disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Studentische*n Mitarbeiter*in
jobs.organisation: DZHW (German Centre for Higher Education Research and Science Studies)
jobs.reason: This is a Studentische*r Mitarbeiter*in (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy, and it requires current enrolment at a German university in a specified discipline. The higher-education research topic is adjacent to the candidate's past RA work but sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: - Projektmitarbeit Interreg Fauna & Gebäude (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is a wildlife-conservation project role centred on animal care (birds/bats), species knowledge and hands-on rehabilitation — fields entirely outside the candidate's research, law and policy profile, and it asks for practical animal-care experience and species expertise they lack. It is a genuine paid role and does not require a disqualifying qualification or language (English/French are only desirable), so it is eligible, but the paper fit and interest are both near-zero.

jobs.title: Projektleitung zum Schutz der Wiesenweihe (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is a project-lead ("Projektleitung") role requiring a specialist M.Sc. in (agricultural) biology, geosciences or nature conservation plus experience leading larger implementation projects — a senior/leadership title with essential qualifications and experience the candidate lacks. It is a conservation science role entirely outside the candidate's international-law and policy profile.

jobs.title: Studentische:r Angestellte:r (M/W/D) in der Kommunikationsabteilung
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a Werkstudent (working-student) role, which is excluded by policy, and it also requires enrolment at a German university, which the candidate no longer satisfies. Although peace and security research is a core interest zone, the student side-role nature is a hard disqualifier.
